title: Custom Order
lede: Send a photograph and get it back as a painting — on canvas or as a poster, in the size you choose.
steps: Choose canvas or poster, and the size.
Pay, and it goes into production.
timing: Painting takes [7–14] days. Delivery is [3–7] business days in the region and [7–20] worldwide, tracked. You get a photograph of the finished piece before it ships.
photo_help: The sharper the photograph, the better the painting. Faces should be clearly lit and in focus.

rights.label: One of one
rights.note: Painted for you and nobody else. Never listed in the shop.

rights.note: We may offer prints of it later. You still get the original piece.
